title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

**Company:** Cosysta  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala / Hybrid  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Role:** Leadership – Technology \& Product Engineering

About Cosysta

Cosysta is a technology company focused on building modern software products, AI\-enabled solutions, digital transformation platforms, web applications, mobile applications, and custom technology solutions for clients in India and international markets.

We are looking for a strong, hands\-on **Chief Technology Officer (CTO)** who can take complete ownership of Cosysta’s technology function and build a scalable engineering organisation.

Role Overview

The CTO will be responsible for the overall technology strategy, software architecture, engineering quality, product development, technical delivery, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and technology team development at Cosysta.

This is not purely a management position. The CTO should be capable of reviewing architecture, solving difficult technical problems, guiding developers, interacting with clients, estimating projects, and ensuring successful delivery.

Key ResponsibilitiesTechnology Strategy \& Leadership

* Define and execute Cosysta’s long\-term technology roadmap.
* Select appropriate technologies, platforms, frameworks, cloud infrastructure, and development standards.
* Ensure technology decisions support scalability, security, performance, profitability, and business growth.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, particularly AI, automation, cloud computing, SaaS, and modern application development.
* Work closely with the CEO, CMO, CFO, and other leadership members on company strategy.

Software \& Product Architecture

* Design and review scalable software architectures.
* Lead architecture decisions for web, mobile, SaaS, enterprise, AI and cloud\-based applications.
* Establish coding standards, development practices and documentation standards.
* Conduct technical reviews of critical projects.
* Reduce technical debt and improve maintainability of products.

AI \& Emerging Technologies

* Lead the integration of AI and machine learning capabilities into Cosysta products and client solutions.
* Evaluate LLMs, AI APIs, RAG systems, AI agents, automation tools and related technologies.
* Identify commercially viable AI products and services.
* Ensure responsible, secure and cost\-efficient implementation of AI systems.

Engineering Team Leadership

* Build and manage a high\-performing technology team.
* Recruit developers, technical leads, AI engineers, QA engineers and DevOps professionals as required.
* Mentor junior and senior developers.
* Conduct technical interviews and skill evaluations.
* Define individual and team KPIs.
* Establish accountability for quality, timelines and delivery.

Project \& Client Delivery

* Take technical ownership of major client projects.
* Participate in technical discussions with clients.
* Convert business requirements into appropriate technical solutions.
* Support project estimation, timelines and resource planning.
* Identify technical risks before project commencement.
* Ensure projects are delivered according to agreed scope, quality and deadlines.
* Support the sales team during technical presentations and proposal discussions.

Development \& Quality Assurance

* Establish development workflows including:
* Git and version\-control standards
* Code reviews
* CI/CD
* Automated testing
* QA processes
* Release management
* Documentation
* Monitor application performance and reliability.
* Ensure proper testing before production releases.
* Implement processes to minimise bugs and production failures.

Cloud, Infrastructure \& DevOps

* Oversee cloud infrastructure and deployment architecture.
* Manage or supervise platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Vercel or equivalent infrastructure.
* Improve deployment automation and infrastructure efficiency.
* Monitor infrastructure and cloud expenditure.
* Establish backup, disaster recovery and business\-continuity procedures.

Cybersecurity \& Data Protection

* Establish security standards for Cosysta and client projects.
* Ensure secure coding practices.
* Protect company source code, intellectual property and customer data.
* Implement access\-control and credential\-management policies.
* Ensure appropriate security reviews for production systems.
* Support compliance requirements where relevant.

Technology Operations

* Maintain proper documentation for all major technology systems.
* Ensure company repositories, domains, hosting, cloud accounts, APIs and technology assets remain under proper organisational control.
* Maintain technology vendor relationships.
* Introduce tools and automation that improve developer productivity.

Expected Technology Exposure

The ideal candidate should have strong experience across several of the following areas:

* JavaScript / TypeScript
* React
* Next.js
* Node.js
* Python
* REST APIs
* Modern databases
* PostgreSQL / MySQL
* MongoDB or NoSQL technologies
* Cloud infrastructure
* AWS / Azure / GCP
* Vercel
* Docker
* Git / GitHub
* CI/CD
* SaaS architecture
* Mobile application development
* AI/ML integration
* LLM APIs
* RAG and AI\-agent architecture
* Cybersecurity
* DevOps
* System design and scalable architecture

The CTO is not expected to personally code every project but must possess enough technical depth to **review, challenge, guide and take responsibility for technical decisions**.

Required Experience

* Preferably **8\+ years of software development / technology experience**.
* Strong experience in software architecture and engineering leadership.
* Previous experience leading developers or technical teams.
* Demonstrated experience delivering commercial software projects.
* Strong understanding of modern web and cloud technologies.
* Experience working directly with customers and business stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving and technical decision\-making ability.

Experience in a startup, software services company, SaaS company or product\-development organisation will be highly valuable.

Preferred Profile

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Are hands\-on technology leaders rather than purely administrative managers.
* Can build a technology department from an early stage.
* Understand both software engineering and business requirements.
* Are comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.
* Can communicate technical matters clearly to non\-technical clients.
* Have experience working with international customers.
* Understand project cost, engineering productivity and commercial viability.
* Can create reusable technology frameworks rather than rebuilding everything from scratch.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be measured through areas such as:

* On\-time technology delivery
* Project quality
* Reduction in production bugs
* Development productivity
* Technology\-team performance
* Architecture quality
* System uptime and reliability
* Infrastructure cost optimisation
* Client satisfaction on technical delivery
* Security and compliance
* Successful implementation of AI capabilities
* Development of reusable technology assets and products

First 90\-Day Expectations

During the first three months, the CTO will be expected to:

* Conduct a complete audit of existing Cosysta technologies, source code, infrastructure and active projects.
* Review the technical capabilities of the existing development team.
* Establish coding, Git, QA, documentation and deployment standards.
* Prepare Cosysta's technology roadmap.
* Identify critical technology risks.
* Recommend the required engineering team structure.
* Improve project estimation and technical delivery systems.
* Establish security, backup and access\-control procedures.
* Develop an AI integration roadmap for Cosysta products and services.
* Build a scalable technology foundation capable of supporting international expansion.

Reporting Structure

The CTO will be part of the **Core Leadership Team of Cosysta** and will work closely with:

* Chief Executive Officer / Managing Leadership
* Chief Marketing Officer
* Chief Financial Officer
* Operations / Project Management Team

The CTO will have authority over the company's engineering, technical architecture, development standards and technology\-delivery functions.

Ideal Candidate

Cosysta needs a **builder CTO** — someone who can move comfortably between boardroom discussions, client meetings, system architecture, code reviews and engineering\-team mentoring.

The objective is not simply to manage developers, but to build a **high\-quality, scalable and commercially strong technology organisation capable of serving international clients and developing Cosysta's own technology products**.

Pay: ₹21,772\.93 \- ₹70,116\.86 per month

title: Territory Manager - Energy Based Device
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.


**A Day in the Life**
=====================

.
  

The Energy\-Based Devices portfolio focuses on technologies that support tissue dissection, vessel sealing, and procedural efficiency across a broad range of surgical procedures. This customer\-facing commercial role partners with surgeons, operating room staff, hospital stakeholders, and channel partners to support product adoption, utilisation, and territory growth across assigned healthcare accounts.  

  

  



This position is based in Kochi and is a field\-based role requiring regular customer visits, operating room presence, account management activities, and engagement with healthcare professionals. Travel of approximately 70% is required within the assigned territory.  

  

  



**Job Description field**  

  



The Territory Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding product utilization, developing customer relationships, and executing territory strategies across the Energy\-Based Devices portfolio. The role works closely with healthcare professionals to support product evaluations, identify growth opportunities, and achieve territory business objectives.  

  

  



**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned**  

  



* Achieve territory sales targets and focus product objectives through effective account planning and customer engagement.
* Promote and support utilization of Energy\-Based Devices products across hospitals, surgical center's, and healthcare institutions.
* Maintain regular operating room presence to support product evaluations, clinical use, and customer training activities.
* Develop and manage key customer accounts, including account profiling, opportunity identification, and growth planning.
* Build and strengthen relationships with surgeons, key opinion leaders, hospital stakeholders, medical associations, and Centre's of Excellence.
* Collect and analyze market intelligence, including competitor activity, product utilization trends, and procedural data.
* Organize approved educational programmes, customer engagement initiatives, and marketing activities in partnership with internal stakeholders.
Maintain accurate and timely reporting of sales activities, territory performance, and focus product trackers.  
* 

**Required Qualifications**  

  



* High School Diploma and 6\+ years OR Associate's Degree and 4\+ years OR Bachelor's Degree and 2\+ years of experience in surgical medical device sales.
* Current or previous experience selling Energy\-Based Devices, surgical products, or high\-end medical capital equipment.
* Experience supporting healthcare professionals within operating room environments.
* Experience managing hospital accounts, customer relationships, and territory sales performance.
Ability to travel extensively within the assigned territory.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  



* Experience with energy devices, electrosurgery, advanced surgical technologies, or operating room\-based product portfolios.
* Experience building relationships with surgeons, hospital procurement teams, key opinion leaders, and healthcare administrators.
* Experience conducting product demonstrations, clinical evaluations, and customer education programmes.
* Experience analyzing market trends, competitive activity, and customer needs to support territory growth strategies.
Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams including marketing, sales operations, and commercial leadership.  
* 

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**  

  

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co\-workers.  



**ABOUT MEDTRONIC**  

  



Together, we can change healthcare worldwide. At Medtronic, we push the limits of what technology can do to help alleviate pain, restore health and extend life. We challenge ourselves and each other to make tomorrow better than yesterday. It is what makes this an exciting and rewarding place to be.  



  

We can accelerate and advance our ability to create meaningful innovations – but we will only succeed with the right people on our team. Let’s work together to address universal healthcare needs and improve patients’ lives. Help us shape the future.  



**Physical Job Requirements**  

  

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:  



  

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

title: Chief Marketing Manager
description:
Chief Marketing ManagerCosysta \| Kochi, Kerala

**Company:** Cosysta  
**Website:** cosysta.com  
**Location:** Kaloor, Kochi, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 5\+ years in marketing, preferably in IT services, SaaS, software, or technology consulting

About Cosysta

Cosysta is an AI\-powered technology and digital solutions company delivering websites, software, mobile applications, ERP systems, AI solutions, digital marketing, and business automation services.

We are looking for a **Chief Marketing Manager** who can build and lead our marketing function, strengthen the Cosysta brand, generate qualified business opportunities, and establish a scalable marketing system for domestic and international markets.

Job Summary

The Chief Marketing Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, and managing Cosysta’s overall marketing strategy. The role combines **brand building, digital marketing, lead generation, content strategy, campaign management, marketing analytics, and team leadership**.

The ideal candidate should be capable of converting marketing efforts into measurable business outcomes and building a structured marketing department from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Marketing Strategy \& Leadership**

* Develop and execute Cosysta’s overall marketing strategy.
* Build quarterly and annual marketing plans aligned with business objectives.
* Establish marketing processes, workflows, KPIs, and reporting systems.
* Lead and manage the marketing team, agencies, freelancers, and external partners.
* Coordinate with sales, product, design, and development teams.

**2\. Brand Development**

* Strengthen Cosysta’s positioning as an AI\-powered technology and business solutions provider.
* Maintain consistent brand identity across websites, social media, proposals, advertisements, and campaigns.
* Develop brand messaging for Indian, GCC, European, and US markets.
* Identify opportunities for partnerships, events, industry visibility, and thought leadership.

**3\. Digital Marketing \& Lead Generation**

* Plan and manage SEO, AEO, social media marketing, Google Ads, Meta Ads, email marketing, and content marketing.
* Generate qualified leads for software development, ERP, AI solutions, websites, and digital services.
* Build and optimize landing pages, lead funnels, remarketing campaigns, and conversion systems.
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize budgets based on results.
* Work with the sales team to improve lead quality and conversion rates.

**4\. Content \& Communication**

* Develop content strategies for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, blogs, and other relevant channels.
* Oversee marketing creatives, videos, case studies, presentations, brochures, and proposals.
* Create content that communicates business value rather than merely promoting software features.
* Coordinate with designers, video editors, copywriters, and technical teams.

**5\. Market Research \& Growth**

* Research competitors, industry trends, customer segments, and emerging markets.
* Identify new marketing channels, partnerships, and business opportunities.
* Develop market\-entry strategies for target regions.
* Track competitor positioning, pricing communication, and promotional activities.
* Support product marketing for Cosysta’s software and business automation solutions.

**6\. Analytics \& Performance**

* Define and monitor marketing KPIs such as:
* Qualified leads generated
* Cost per lead
* Marketing\-qualified leads
* Conversion rate
* Customer acquisition cost
* Website traffic and conversions
* Campaign ROI
* Brand reach and engagement
* Prepare regular marketing performance reports for management.
* Use tools such as Google Analytics, Search Console, Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, CRM platforms, and reporting dashboards.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
* **5\+ years of relevant marketing experience**, preferably in IT, SaaS, software, digital services, or technology companies.
* Demonstrated experience in digital marketing and lead generation.
* Strong understanding of SEO, paid advertising, social media, content marketing, and conversion optimization.
* Experience managing marketing teams or external marketing resources.
* Strong communication, presentation, analytical, and leadership skills.
* Ability to create and execute marketing strategies independently.
* Ability to work with technical teams and understand software products.

Preferred Skills

* Experience marketing software development, ERP, AI, SaaS, or IT services.
* Experience with B2B marketing and international lead generation.
* Knowledge of LinkedIn marketing and account\-based marketing.
* Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, and funnel management.
* Understanding of AEO, AI search visibility, and modern content strategies.
* Experience with WordPress or other CMS platforms, Google Analytics, Search Console, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Canva, or similar tools.
* Strong copywriting and campaign planning skills.
* Experience building a marketing department or marketing SOPs.

Key Performance Expectations

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Build a structured and accountable marketing function.
* Establish a consistent lead\-generation pipeline.
* Improve Cosysta’s online brand presence and market positioning.
* Develop repeatable marketing campaigns and reporting systems.
* Support customer acquisition in India and international markets.
* Coordinate marketing activities with sales and business development.
* Demonstrate measurable improvement in marketing performance
